title: Price Frictions and the Success of New Products
eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. Cross-sectional comparisons of new products (and products in new stores) at entry: reghdfe of product exit or price change on a state item-pricing-law indicator (item_policy, time-invariant), 99-cent endings, coinciding price changes or product anniversaries, with chain x quarter and UPC fixed effects. No treatment that switches on at unit-specific dates within a panel.
design_notes: Table3.do: new_low_items.dta merged with market_map_state (item vs no-item states); reghdfe p_change/exit item_policy, a(chain_quarter upc) vce(cluster chain-upc); also 'ending'. Table4.do: same for new stores (first quarter after store opening). Figure2_Figure3_Table2.do: reghdfe exit/p_change on change_n, at_least_one, pct0, coinciding. Observations are chain-UPC entry events, not a unit-by-time panel with policy adoption.
data_files_note: Readme.txt: 'Requires access to the IRI scanner dataset.' Only do-files shipped.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
